note: P4362 (Pro 30:5) — every word of God proves true; he is a shield to those who take refuge in him.

dims.v: God-reliance — the trust that shelters in God as a shield
the taking of refuge in God, who is a shield to all who do so — the reliance that shelters in God and his ever-true word, finding him a proven protection
(God the shield in whom refuge is taken)
the trust that flees to God for shelter and is not disappointed

chasah (take refuge/shelter) — 'he is a shield to those who TAKE REFUGE in him' (30:5); God's word is flawless and he himself a shield to those who trust him. To take refuge in God is to be sheltered by a proven, faithful protection (cf 18:10; Ps 18:30).
